goal: Close Phase 8 validation: run all deterministic graders, resolve dirty macOS files, verify backend connectivity, and prepare closeout documentation

design_references.purpose: Single source of truth for Like-minded visual language, copy tone, interaction principles, and iOS/macOS design rules.
usage: Before iOS native UI work, consult DESIGN.md and the relevant screen-range images in mockups/ios/.
Before macOS native UI work, consult DESIGN.md and the relevant screen-range images in mockups/macos/.
Skip mockups for backend-only, validation-only, or non-visual changes.

local_simulator.purpose: Build, install, and launch the simulator app; prove fresh auth gate and DEBUG signed-in Meet/Circles/Communities/Profile path.
reuse_when: Local API auth or MVP placement routes change.

external_preflight.purpose: Verify real Render, Neon, Apple, LiveKit, TestFlight, and manual proof recorded in release/testflight-evidence.json.

macos_backend_connectivity.purpose: Build the LikemindedMac target and verify macOS backend reachability while the validation API serves data/validation-db.

proves: Fresh simulator launch shows the Sign in with Apple gate.
DEBUG local auth reaches the signed-in Meet/Circles/Communities/Profile path after current native changes.

external_preflight.next_agent_action: Treat as a later release gate after repo-owned hardening is complete; ask the user to fill release/testflight-evidence.json only when external setup and device proof are ready.

runtime_evidence.circles: 2 joined circles from /v1/me/circles plus /v1/circles/:id client wiring
runtime_evidence.meetings: 1 upcoming meeting and RSVP state from /v1/meetings/upcoming

does_not_prove: Full visual parity with macOS mockups.
Screen capture validation without resetting/removing validation data.

release_gate.external_preflight: Run npm run verify:external-preflight only after Render, Neon, Apple Developer, App Store Connect/TestFlight, and manual device proof are ready.

agent_guardrails: If goal.json status is completed, select the next coherent unchecked surface from PROGRESS.md before querying context.
Avoid tiny one-checkbox goals unless they are the only blocker; group adjacent small items under the same owner surface.
Check validation_state before rerunning completed proof.
Reuse validation_inventory scripts before creating validation scripts.
Do not add docs or workflows for validation already covered by workflow_refs and validation_inventory.

deterministic_graders.name: node_syntax
deterministic_graders.proves: JavaScript entrypoints and grader scripts parse.

deterministic_graders.name: mvp_backend_contract
deterministic_graders.proves: Auth-gated discovery, persisted profile/placement, placement action, feedback, meetings RSVP/scheduling, LiveKit token generation, and cross-user isolation work locally.

deterministic_graders.name: release_static_config
deterministic_graders.proves: TestFlight-critical bundle id, entitlements, API base URL, LiveKit env vars, Render env, and privacy-policy files are configured.

deterministic_graders.name: goal_contract
deterministic_graders.proves: goal.json and goal.template.json contain the current grader, validation, rubric, and agent routing contract.

deterministic_graders.name: repo_docs_lint
deterministic_graders.proves: Repo docs follow the local workflow documentation contract.

deterministic_graders.name: validation_data_lifecycle
deterministic_graders.proves: Validation API can attach a separate local database and seed deterministic backend data for profile, circles, communities, meetings, soulmate, and chat flows.

deterministic_graders.name: macos_screen_capture
deterministic_graders.proves: LikemindedMac builds and every MacPrototypeScreen can be launched and captured for mockup comparison.

deterministic_graders.name: macos_backend_connectivity
deterministic_graders.proves: LikemindedMac app connects to backend API for auth, profile, circles, communities, meetings, soulmate, messages, and notifications; renders real data instead of static prototypes.

deterministic_graders.name: local_simulator
deterministic_graders.proves: Fresh iOS simulator launch shows the auth gate and DEBUG local-auth navigation reaches the signed-in native tab path.

preferred_agent.name: validation-release
preferred_agent.use_when: Simulator or build verification is read-heavy, screenshot-based, or likely to produce long logs.

checks: Fresh install shows Sign in with Apple gate, not old prototype tabs.
After sign-in, tabs are Meet, Circles, Communities, Profile.
Meet can load RSVP state and scheduled meetup cards through the authenticated backend path.
LiveKit join path requests a participant token only for scheduled meeting participants.
Circles accept/swap/defer visibly round-trips through backend state.
Profile edit and feedback paths are visible and retryable.

subagents.default_policy: Do not create new agents unless repeated work is not already owned by an existing project agent.

allowed.name: validation-release
can_do: summarize failing assertions and likely owner files
cannot_do: edit files unless the main thread assigns a bounded patch

allowed.name: native-app
can_do: bounded SwiftUI/native project fixes after deterministic failure evidence
cannot_do: replace the native project strategy without approval

allowed.name: backend-authority
can_do: bounded backend auth, persistence, or API contract fixes after deterministic failure evidence

completion_commit.when: After all required deterministic and local simulator validation passes, and before marking the session goal complete.

done_criteria: All deterministic graders pass (node_syntax, mvp_backend_contract, release_static_config, goal_contract, repo_docs_lint, validation_data_lifecycle, macos_screen_capture, macos_backend_connectivity, local_simulator).
PROGRESS.md is updated with Phase 8 closeout notes.
Validation_state in goal.json reflects current proof state.
Manual Phase 8 items are documented as pending manual verification.
Validated session changes are committed with the session's goal.json before the goal is marked completed.
